title: PIRIN EXTREME - ROUTE C (storm reroute) 36.9km / 2350m D+
terrain: Route C, weather reroute. 36.9km, 2350m D+ / 2360m D-, high point 2584m (no Vihren summit). Km 0-10 climb 924->1808m (Banderitsa aid, 877 D+). Km 10-13 steep climb to 2402m, km 13-15.4 descent 530m to h. Vihren aid. Km 15.4-19 climb to 2544m (high point), km 19-24.5 descent 750m to h. Demyanitsa aid (1792m). Km 24.5-36.9 forest descent 1106 D- to Bansko, ~9% avg, runnable. Storms forecast from 12:00-13:00, intensifying 13:30-14:00.

steps.target: Km 0-10 to Banderitsa. Run km 0-5 (6%), hike from km 5. 135-148 bpm
Km 10-15.4. Steep hike to 2402m then 530m descent to h. Vihren. 145-158 up, 135-150 down
Km 15.4-24.5. Climb to 2544m high point, 750m descent to Demyanitsa. 145-155 up, 130-150 down, 170+ spm
Km 24.5-36.9. Forest descent 1106m to Bansko. 130-150 bpm, 175 spm, poles

coachNotes:
ROUTE C, NOT THE ORIGINAL. 1000m less climb, 1000m less descent, 320m lower. Estimate 6h30 (range 6h15-7h00), finish ~14:30. Splits: Banderitsa 1:45 (cut 2:30), h. Vihren 3:20 (cut 5:00), Demyanitsa 5:10, finish 6:30. Last two hours are shorter than trained for, so you can run the two climbs 5-10 bpm harder than the original plan.
WEATHER IS THE RACE PLAN. Storms from 12-13h, worse 13:30-14. Exposed above 2000m is km 11-22, on the splits above that is 10:20-12:45. Be over the km 19 high point by 12:15 and into the trees below Demyanitsa by 13:00. Do not linger at h. Vihren, max 2 min. If thunder while above 2000m, keep moving down, poles in the pack. Waterproof jacket, gloves, buff and a dry base layer in a bag are mandatory kit, not optional. Wet rock: brake with poles and cadence, not quads.
FUEL 80 g/h, rehearsed system, 6h30 = ~520g. 1 Isocarb C2:1 PRO sachet in 500ml per hour (60g, 600mg Na) + 1 Carbo Gel C2:1 PRO every second hour (hours 2, 4, 6). Carry 7 sachets, 4 gels (1 spare). Aid-station solids REPLACE that hour's gel, never stack: 1 banana (~25g) or 2 dates (~10g) or 150ml cola (~15g). Salty at Demyanitsa: chips, cheese, salami, lyutenitsa, 5-10 pieces, breaks the sweetness for the descent. Soup only if the hut confirms no flour or noodles. Gluten-free confirmed by organiser: bananas, apples, cucumbers, dates, cheese, cola, isotonic. Skip anything unlabeled.
WATER on the clock: 125ml every 15min, 500ml/h (cool day, no need for more). Carry 2x500ml flasks Isocarb + 1x500ml plain water for gels. Refill at each aid: 1 sachet flask + plain. Longest gap Vihren-Demyanitsa 1h50 = 900ml, fits. 15min repeating watch alarm.
ITB: total descent 2360m in three blocks (530, 750, 1106), no single 1250m drop. Final descent is 9% avg, forest, runnable: 175 spm target, 170 floor, short stride, poles active. Any lateral right knee signal: walk 5 min, poles heavy, reassess. Pin signal that persists: walk it in, you finish anyway with 14h cut-off.
STATUS 11 Sep: RHR 46, HRV 48 (down from 60 Mon, travel and 900m noise), sleep 80, TSB +6.4 rising to ~+8 at the gun, CTL 43. Green.
